title: The Quiet Clock
author: Elodie Sandoval
blurb: August Nakamura, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
